purpose: Public connector contracts, not an evidence inventory. No sources or cases are preloaded; availability requires fresh acceptance.

entries.scope: Full current published Hospice General Information CSV snapshot; Medicare certification/provider characteristics, not individual claims or all hospice organizations
entries.rights: Catalog accessLevel public; no blanket redistribution licence asserted
limitations: CCN is not NPI
Version/period from catalog must accompany analysis
No evidence of individual fraudulent visits

entries.scope: Full published Home Health Care Agencies CSV snapshot; quality/provider characteristics, not individual claims
entries.rights: Catalog accessLevel public; no blanket redistribution licence asserted
limitations: Multiple measures may span different periods
Do not interpret measures as payments
Check source footnotes/suppression

entries.scope: Organization provider registry, bounded queries of hospice/home health taxonomy
entries.access: Public GET, no key; up to 200 rows/query, skip bounded by API
limitations: Not complete national enumeration
No proof of certification, billing, licensure or wrongdoing
Not award-level or recipient-payment integration
Does not establish a case funding nexus

entries.scope: Acquire current public portal and written DOJ rules on demand; no snapshots bundled
limitations: Scope discrepancy recorded in docs/PROGRAM-RULES.md
Changes need human/agent reading, not automatic legal interpretation

entries.scope: Current active LEIE snapshot, catalog-discovered; separate bulk/Parquet store
limitations: Not complete historical exclusion coverage; reinstatement and waivers require dated evidence
Validate NPI format/check digit/placeholders; name-only matches are not confirmed excluded entities
Public DOB/address fields remain in originals; omit unnecessary personal identifiers from reports

entries.scope: Recipient awards, subawards and obligation/outlay data
limitations: Agency reference connector is not an awards connector
API endpoints, rate/cost and source semantics must be verified before integration

entries.scope: Program-specific public loan data if available
limitations: No current loan connector implemented
Do not infer fraud from loan forgiveness or borrower names

entries.scope: Jurisdiction-specific public licensing/subsidy sources, not a presumed national dataset
limitations: Define federal program link first
Coverage and identifiers vary

entries.scope: Must be defined by relevant official program documentation before campaign selection

limitations: Key/account/access requirements require approval and source-specific validation

entries.scope: Catalog-discovered current CMS hospice CHOW transaction CSV; archive/member/Parquet hashes
limitations: CHOW is not necessarily a direct majority transfer
Snapshot is not complete historical coverage
Reversible Latin-1 structural decoding; non-ASCII names need encoding validation
No payment evidence or violation inference

entries.scope: Current CMS hospice ownership-interest snapshot in separate bulk/Parquet store
limitations: Self-reported current roles are not historical control or transaction evidence
Rows are ownership interests, not unique providers
Structural encoding only; no normalized name matching

entries.scope: Current CMS enrollment snapshot plus additional-NPI companion; IDs preserved as strings
limitations: No assumed one-to-one CCN/NPI/enrollment crosswalk
Current approval is not historical enrollment continuity or proof of billing

entries.scope: Latest published monthly reinstatement CSV discovered from OIG catalog
limitations: One monthly supplement is not complete reinstatement history
Do not infer historic eligibility solely from a current exclusion snapshot

entries.scope: Documented billing/servicing NPI by HCPCS and service-month aggregates; bulk file not acquired
limitations: No Medicaid bulk connector implemented
Requires bounded large-file source contract
Suppressed cells and preliminary data; not visits, clinical facts or complete national expenditures
